Gets Basic Boundary by Location.

query.description: (Required) Latitude around which Basic Boundary is requested
(Required) Longitude around which Basic Boundary is requested
(Required) This is width of the buffer (in a complete circular buffer, it would be radius of the buffer). This has to be a positive number.

This is resolution of the buffer. Curves generated in buffer are approximated by line segments and it is measured in segments per circle. The higher the resolution, the smoother the curves of the buffer but more points would be required in the boundary geometry. Number greater than 0 and in multiple of 4. If not in 4, then it is approximated to nearest multiple of 4.
